text.p: Tropical Depression 05W caused heavy rains and severe flooding over Luzon, Philippines on Monday. This system has moved east of Luzon and into the Philippine Sea where it is expected to intensify slowly while turning more northward, threatening some shipping. Top winds near the center of the system increase to 50 mph during the next 12 hours before it begins to weaken again. Rain is tapering off in Luzon, Philippines. Flooding will gradually ease during the next 5 days.

Tropical Depression 06W is mostly a threat to shipping in the region well to the east-southeast of Guam. Top winds are currently 30 mph but they may reach 60 mph in about 72 hours. The system moves west and then north during this period.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY WEATHER STATEMENTS
